quick_skim.title: Sub-Riemannian flow matching
quick_skim.abstract: We study sub-Riemannian conditional flow matching (SRCFM) for generative transport with prescribed velocity constraints. Training uses paths between sampled source and target points whose velocities lie in the allowed horizontal directions at each state. A neural network takes time and the full state as input and predicts the coefficients of these directions, and the horizontal frame then determines the full velocity used for generation. We describe constructions based on Heisenberg geodesics and joint endpoint equations in free step-two Carnot groups. We propose a scalable piecewise algorithm that computes horizontal paths directly from their endpoints. A straight segment sets the horizontal coordinates, and a loop in those coordinates corrects the remaining vertical displacement. We verify the algorithm's endpoint accuracy to numerical precision in high-dimensional tests. Synthetic experiments illustrate approximate distribution transport along horizontal trajectories. On resized MNIST, we use the same construction to generate images from Gaussian inputs with fewer controls than pixels.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Sub-Riemannian conditional flow matching learns generative transport under prescribed horizontal velocity constraints, with Heisenberg geodesic constructions and a scalable piecewise algorithm.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 该文针对流匹配在生成传输中需要满足特定速度约束的问题，提出亚黎曼条件流匹配，使生成路径的速度始终位于允许的水平方向。方法利用Heisenberg测地线和自由二步Carnot群中的端点方程构造路径，并给出从端点直接计算水平路径的分段可扩展算法。研究验证了该框架在受约束生成传输中的可行性，为几何约束下的流匹配提供了新工具。
quick_skim.llm_tldr: 该文针对流匹配在生成传输中需要满足特定速度约束的问题，提出亚黎曼条件流匹配，使生成路径的速度始终位于允许的水平方向。方法利用Heisenberg测地线和自由二步Carnot群中的端点方程构造路径，并给出从端点直接计算水平路径的分段可扩展算法。研究验证了该框架在受约束生成传输中的可行性，为几何约束下的流匹配提供了新工具。
quick_skim.llm_motivation_cn: 流匹配生成传输通常缺少对速度方向的几何约束，限制了其在特定流形上的应用。
quick_skim.llm_method_cn: 提出亚黎曼条件流匹配，用神经网络预测水平方向系数，并基于Heisenberg测地线构造可扩展路径算法。
quick_skim.llm_result_cn: 方法能够从端点直接计算满足水平速度约束的生成路径，并在受约束传输任务上验证有效性。
quick_skim.llm_conclusion_cn: 该工作拓展了流匹配的几何形式，为带速度约束的生成建模提供理论基础和算法。
